# NarutoCardGuide

> NarutoCardGuide is an independent reference site for the NARUTO CARD GAME, covering confirmed cards, rules, beginner explanations, deck guides, official news, products, and events.

NarutoCardGuide is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bandai or the NARUTO rights holders. Information is compiled from confirmed announcements and official materials where available.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://narutocardguide.com/): Overview of the site, recent news, featured cards, and beginner resources.
- [Cards List](https://narutocardguide.com/cards-list/): Browse revealed cards grouped by starter deck, first set, demo cards, Chakra cards, and Summon cards.
- [Beginner Guides](https://narutocardguide.com/beginner-guides/): Learn the rules, card types, game vocabulary, and core fundamentals.
- [Deck Guides](https://narutocardguide.com/deck-guides/): Explore practical deck plans, leader strategies, mulligan guidance, and upgrade paths.
- [News and Roadmap](https://narutocardguide.com/news/): Read official announcements, card reveals, product updates, event information, and roadmap dates.

## Key guides

- [Complete Naruto Card Game Rules](https://narutocardguide.com/beginner-guides/complete-naruto-card-game-rules/): Explanation of the game flow, zones, turns, card types, attacks, Chakra, and effects.
- [Glossary: Card Stats, Keywords, and Game Vocabulary](https://narutocardguide.com/beginner-guides/glossary-key-terms/): Reference for the terms and keywords used in the NARUTO CARD GAME.
- [Naruto Uzumaki Demo Deck](https://narutocardguide.com/deck-guides/naruto-uzumaki-demo-deck/): A simple decklist and practical strategy guide for learning through play.

## Related resources

- [Legal Notice and Privacy](https://narutocardguide.com/legal-notice-and-privacy/): Site ownership, contact information, privacy, analytics, and external-link information.
